name: Quaternius Universal Animation Library Standard
author: Quaternius
acquisition: Downloaded from the official Quaternius link in the in-app browser, 2026-10-02.
rootMotion: Disabled in the author-provided UAL1_Standard.glb; the _RM variant is not used.
manifestMaintenance: Independent source manifest linked from the shared README. Neither build-assets.mjs nor build-motions.mjs generates or overwrites this file. Keep the fixed source hashes and license files when rebuilding derived assets.
referencePose: A_TPose is used only for numerical target-rest recovery verification.
notes: The complete small source GLB is retained to reproduce the three selected derived clips. The source rig and animation samples are not edited.

runtimeValidation.method: Loaded the generated canonical GLBs with Three GLTFLoader and the serialized clips with AnimationClip.parse. AnimationMixer sampled four times per clip and the five body-direction vectors matched the independent retarget calculation. For this CPU-only check, material/image references were removed in memory; the files were unchanged.
runtimeValidation.visualAcceptance: Not asserted by this CPU validation; inspect in the maker viewer.
